description: Nextflow/nf-core fallback agent — owns workflow and subworkflow logic, channel plumbing, nextflow.config/conf/*.config, and pipeline architecture, always to nf-core standard (strict syntax, meta maps, nf-schema, ext.args). Use for any Nextflow task that no nf-core-* specialist owns; module/subworkflow lifecycle goes to nf-core-modules and nf-test to nf-core-testing.
